Our criteria

What Gamr looks for.

Check your game against these before you pitch. Projects that are too early can be referred to the Lab.

Pitch a Game
  • A playable prototype or vertical slice
  • A clear core loop and a marketable hook
  • A capable, accountable team
  • Clean ownership of the IP
  • A realistic scope, budget and timeline
  • A defined audience and platform
  • A clear reason Gamr can improve the outcome
Review process

From pitch to decision.

One route, start to finish. Every pitch moves through the same seven stages.

  1. Start
    01
    Self-qualification

    Check the criteria.

  2. 02
    Submission

    Send the structured pitch.

  3. 03
    Eligibility review

    Completeness and fit.

  4. 04
    Playtest

    Build and product review.

  5. 05
    Developer call

    Meet the team.

  6. 06
    Diligence

    Technical, legal and commercial.

  7. Go live
    07
    Decision

    Greenlight to launch, re-pitch, Lab referral or decline.

FAQ

Questions developers ask.

Do I keep my IP?

Third-party studios normally keep their underlying IP. Publishing rights are agreed by platform, territory and term.

Does Gamr fund games?

Milestone funding is available where approved. It is agreed per title.

Which platforms?

Roblox, mobile, web and other platforms.

Is my submission confidential?

Yes. Pitches are reviewed only by Gamr’s publishing team and are never shared outside Gamr without your permission.

When will I hear back?

We confirm every submission and aim to give you a first decision within a few weeks.

Who can apply?

African studios, African-led teams and developers with a playable build.

How to pitch

Pitch a game.

A short multi-step form. Have these ready before you start; your pitch goes straight to the publishing team.

Start Your Pitch
  1. 01Studio and team details
  2. 02One-sentence hook
  3. 03Pitch deck
  4. 04Gameplay video
  5. 05Private playable build
  6. 06Target audience and platforms
  7. 07Roadmap, budget and funding request
  8. 08Support requested from Gamr
  9. 09Traction or test data
  10. 10IP ownership declaration
  11. 11Consent and privacy acknowledgement

Selected work

Show the brief. Show the role. Show the result.

Recent projects, each with the client, date, objective, what Gamr did and the result.

Client project · 2024

Spotify

Objective
Build visibility and affinity with Gen Z and Millennial gamers, and connect music with gaming culture.
What Gamr did
A music-and-gaming event at Carven: an FC24 creator showdown, artist and DJ sets, playlist collection and community promotion.
Result
400+ guests, 1,000+ playlist entries and 20M+ combined digital impressions.
Results as published by Gamr
Read the case study →
Client project · 2024

Prime Hydration

Objective
Introduce Prime to Nigeria and position it with gamers and Gen Z.
What Gamr did
Turned Carven into a Prime-branded gaming venue with pods, hydration booths, creators, competitions and social content.
Result
500+ attendees, 1M+ impressions, 22% average engagement and 1,200+ bottles distributed.
Results as published by Gamr
